Subject: Post-demo: encryption & keying preferences — Acme Corporation

Hi Lena / Acme procurement team,

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier today. Quick recap + the follow-ups we promised on encryption and key management so you have a single place to share with security/procurement:

Highlights from the call:
- In-transit: All API traffic to Redwood is TLS 1.2+ with modern cipher suites; mutual TLS available on Dedicated/Private.
- At-rest: Model weights & customer data encrypted at rest; default AES-256-managed keys in cloud.
- Customer-managed keys: We support BYOK via customer KMS (Cloud KMS/HSM) for Dedicated and Private; hosted (shared) endpoints can be configured with dedicated customer key routes for Enterprise plans.
- Auditing/logging: Per-request audit logs (tokenized) available for Private and Dedicated; hosted API exposes request-level logs for compliance plans with retention controls.

Attaching a short brief that maps options to typical procurement ask (CMK vs Redwood-managed, operational trade-offs, expected RTO impact). Also included is a simple retention table template for your team to populate.

Action items I promised:
1) Attach the brief and retention template (attached).
2) Call out the three integration patterns and typical lead times: (a) Hosted + customer key routing (~2–3 weeks), (b) Dedicated with customer KMS (~3–6 weeks), (c) Private on-prem (~8+ weeks).
3) Clarify the exact evidence you need for your security review (SOC2, encryption key attestations, HSM vendor certs).

Could you confirm who from security will own the KMS/HSM technical integration? If you share a preferred time next week we can schedule a short technical walkthrough with Ben and Marissa.

Thanks,
Nikhil Sharma
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
--
Attachment: redwood-cmk-options-brief.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: acme-data-retention-table.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@acmecorp.com>

Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 10:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo: encryption & keying preferences — Acme Corporation

Hi Nikhil,

Appreciate the clear recap and the docs. A couple of clarifications from our side after an initial pass with Security and Procurement:

- Security would prefer customer-managed keys (HSM-backed) for any data classified as PII or financial. We need to know the supported HSM vendors and whether you support PKCS#11 or Cloud HSM APIs.
- On retention: our default is 7 years for logs that map to billing/audit, but for model inputs we currently plan 1 year; need to understand whether Redwood can partition storage so inputs are purged per retention policy.
- Audit logs: we will need an immutable export to our SIEM (S3 -> Splunk pipeline) and proof of tamper-evidence for at least 12 months.

Procurement: can you share a preliminary SOW addendum language around key custody and liability? Also need ballpark pricing delta for CMK vs Redwood-managed for a Dedicated pool (estimate tokens/month = 120M).

On ownership — security will own the integration. I’ll loop in our security lead (cc’d procurement for SOW/questions) if needed.

Thanks,
Lena Ortiz
Director, Security & Compliance
Acme Corporation

Hi Lena — thanks for the detail. Answers inline and next steps below.

- HSM vendors/APIs: We support AWS CloudHSM and Google Cloud HSM for Dedicated and Private deployments and can integrate with on-prem PKCS#11 HSMs for Private installations. Our integration patterns document (attached) outlines supported APIs and the operations model.

- Retention & purge: For Dedicated/Private we can configure tenant-level retention windows and run scheduled secure-delete jobs. Hosted is more constrained but Enterprise plans include per-tenant retention controls; we’ll work with you on exact purge SLAs.

- Immutable export: We can stream audit logs to your S3 bucket with server-side encryption and object-lock for WORM-style retention; Splunk ingestion examples are in the brief.

SOW language: Attached is a short draft SOW addendum that our legal ops often uses for CMK/HSM custody clauses and liability carve-outs.

Pricing: Ben — can you confirm an initial delta for CMK-backed Dedicated pool at ~120M tokens/month? A rough order of magnitude (no contract pricing) will help procurement.

Proposed next steps:
1) Ben/Marissa to confirm high-level pricing delta and any capacity lead-time changes by EOD Wed.
2) We schedule a 45-min technical walkthrough with your security engineer — propose Wed 2/25 10:00–10:45 PT or Thu 2/26 11:00–11:45 PT.
3) Procurement to review SOW addendum and indicate whether they need additional commercial language.

If that works I’ll send calendar invites and include the short technical checklist so your security engineer can prepare.

Best,
Nikhil
